fieldValues.title: Structured discovery: what the query is
fieldValues.summary: A large SRS repository selects records through a portable, deterministic Discovery Contract — implementable identically by every conforming implementation — plus an explicit, declared extension point for implementation-specific selection paths (a vector/similarity query being the named example) that a portable repository never depends on silently. The #525 retirement removed an unplanned query surface, not the need for a planned one.
